headline: Durable Leadership, Margin Normalisation Ahead

highlights: Gross margins improved by 403bps YoY (+698 bps QoQ) at 28.9% in Q2FY27, supported by calibrated pricing and cost optimisation, though the full benefit was masked by ~18% cost inflation and seasonal price lock-ins covering ~35% of volumes.
EBITDA stood at INR 128cr (+81.6% YoY/-51.8% QoQ), below our estimates of INR 135cr.
EBITDA margin improved 172 bps YoY (-96 bps QoQ) to 4.7% in Q2FY27.
PAT stood at INR 48cr (+51.5% YoY/-77.6% YoY), below our estimates of INR 93cr, and PAT margin improved 42 bps YoY (-279 bps QoQ) to 1.8% in Q2FY27.
valuation: Outlook & Valuation: Voltas enters H2FY27 with momentum built on dominant RAC leadership of 17.4% market share and a widened 420bps lead, 32% YoY volume growth, and a long runway from sub-10% penetration, a ~26mn unit installed base entering replacement, and expected El Niño-led summer stocking in Q4.

Voltbek targets EBITDA break-even by FY28E, the projects business carries ~INR 6,800cr of order book at a guided 4-6% sustainable margin, and the ~INR 438cr Sidra guarantee cancellation removes a key contingent overhang.
At CMP INR 1,123, we are upgrading to a “BUY” (earlier “HOLD”) rating at a TP of INR 1,350 per share; valued based on SOTP; upside of 20.2%.
watch: Key Highlights Market leadership anchors structural growth: Voltas enters H2FY27 with a strengthened competitive moat in room air conditioners, holding 17.4% YTD market share and a 420bps lead over the nearest competitor (+120 bps YoY).

Q2 is seasonally the softest quarter, so sequential EBIT improvement into Q3 and a stronger Q4 is the key inflection to track, with downside risk limited if commodity and freight prices continue to soften.
